Israeli Minister Calls for Nightly Killings in Gaza

Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir advocated for killing 30 to 40 people in Gaza each night. He made this statement during a podcast while speaking to a former Israeli hostage. Ben-Gvir also criticized Prime Minister Netanyahu's policies and advocated for the re-establishment of Israeli settlements in Gaza. Some coverage notes that similar past statements by Israeli officials have been presented to the UN's world court as evidence of genocidal intent, a claim Israel denies.
